purpose.zh: 练背部、臀部和大腿后侧
purpose.en: Build your back, glutes, and the backs of your thighs.

text.zh: 手推地把髋抬起，身体成一条直线
text.en: Push the floor away and lift your hips into one straight line

text.zh: 双手在肩膀下面，手指朝脚的方向。
text.en: Keep your hands under your shoulders with fingers toward your feet.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，脚跟踩地，顶上夹紧臀部。
text.en: Keep your arms straight, heels down, and squeeze your glutes at the top.

commonErrors.en: Dropping the head back and letting the shoulders roll forward.

cautions.en: Stop if your wrists hurt or go numb.
Warm up your wrists before you start.

changes: 动画 8 秒 2 次「抬髋-停 1.7 s-放下」，剂量从 20 秒保持改为 3 组×10 次（rep_hold）；名字随之改为「反向平板抬髋 / Reverse Plank Hip Lift」
cue2 删掉动画里没有的「或朝两侧」；「夹紧臀部」从主口令挪到 cue3
口令按相位缩短（抬髋 0.8 s / 放下 0.4 s）
flags: 原设计是保持 20 秒，改成次数是否接受；改名请确认
